title: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS002
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Project is a concentrated solar power facility in Maricopa County, Arizona.
- Piping Installation Subcontractor installs all pipe lines and components as shown on drawings.
- All welded metallic piping 3” and larger will be shop fabricated.
- Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 "Process Piping" for welding.
- Confidential and proprietary information must not be disclosed without permission.
- Field welds for HTF service piping require 100% radiographic examination.
- 5% of all welds for other services will be examined using UT with Shearwave and Phased Array modes.
- Subcontractor is responsible for installing all piping components, supports, and field fabrication.
- All carbon steel pipe spools must be internally cleaned per specific requirements.
- Subcontractor must supply specific materials and fittings for piping installation.
- Debris removal and flushing required before insulation application.
summary_points: Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Project is a concentrated solar power facility in Maricopa County, Arizona.
Piping Installation Subcontractor installs all pipe lines and components as shown on drawings.
All welded metallic piping 3” and larger will be shop fabricated.
Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 "Process Piping" for welding.
Confidential and proprietary information must not be disclosed without permission.
Field welds for HTF service piping require 100% radiographic examination.
5% of all welds for other services will be examined using UT with Shearwave and Phased Array modes.
Subcontractor is responsible for installing all piping components, supports, and field fabrication.
All carbon steel pipe spools must be internally cleaned per specific requirements.
Subcontractor must supply specific materials and fittings for piping installation.
Debris removal and flushing required before insulation application.
Pressure tests must be performed as per specified methods with witness from Abener Teyma representative.
Gaskets must be installed using manufacturer recommended torque values.
